newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Bridgestone, Michelin buys rubber in Singapore.
newsitem.headline: Bridgestone, Michelin buys rubber in Singapore.

text.p: Bridgestone and Michelin were said to have concluded deals on Monday for shipments of RSS3 and TSR20 rubber in an otherwise lethargic Singapore rubber market, dealers said.
"I heard Bridgestone came into the market for TSR20 rubber," a dealer said. "I heard Bridgestone managed to buy something although I'm not sure about the volume."

"I heard Michelin was in. I think they were looking for nearby RSS3 rubber, but they come in almost every week to pick up material," another dealer said, adding major consumers like Michelin and Bridgestone buy regularly in the market.
Trading remained lethargic, however, since many consumers have already put on ample coverage. One dealing house said it was already looking for far forward shipments of rubber.
"If the market moves up half-a-cent, we just sit back. It's no skin off our nose," the dealer said. "It's flat right now. Most of the consumers are covered."

At 0945 GMT, September RSS3 was seen at 94.75 U.S. cents a kg from 95.25 cents. December RSS1 was seen at 148.00 Singapore cents (US$1.01) a kg from 149.25 cents. October TSR20 was seen at 99.00 U.S. cents a kg from 99.75 cents.
